name: no-cohorts-month-end
about: The shape production sends until Q-AD34: no cohorts at all, on the last day of the month (0 days left).

output.headline: On 2026-10-31, both campaigns closed out the month with 7 leads across $284.25 in spend, landing a cost per lead of $40.61.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet led the day with $184.50 spent, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks, 6 leads, and a $30.75 cost per lead at a 1.5% click rate.

Dedicated night runs spent $99.75 for 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, 1 lead, and a $99.75 cost per lead at a 1.1% click rate — worth keeping an eye on given the gap in efficiency between the 2 campaigns.
Combined for the day: 14,600 impressions, 203 clicks, and a 1.4% click rate across both campaigns.

No cohort data was recorded for this period, so there is nothing to report on lead progression stages today.
